context: Tests whether the agent correctly uses the agent-pane CLI to read a browser page on behalf of a user who asked for a summary. The agent should check the environment before issuing agent-pane commands, prefer the markdown or info format over dom, read the page autonomously without asking the user to paste content, and cite the page source in its output.

checklist.name: Env check runs
checklist.description: The agent runs a shell command containing `env` and `grep` before issuing any agent-pane page command

checklist.name: Env check ordered first
checklist.description: The env grep command is executed BEFORE the first `agent-pane page` command — not after

checklist.name: AGENT_PANE in env pattern
checklist.description: The env grep command's pattern matches `AGENT_PANE` (e.g. contains AGENT_PANE in the regex or as a literal string)

checklist.name: TERM_PROGRAM in env pattern
checklist.description: The env grep command's pattern also matches `TERM_PROGRAM` (e.g. the regex covers TERM_PROGRAM)

checklist.name: No dom as first read
checklist.description: The agent does NOT use `agent-pane page dom` as its first page-read command — the first page format is `info`, `markdown`, or another non-dom format

checklist.name: Uses info or markdown
checklist.description: The agent calls `agent-pane page info` or `agent-pane page markdown` at least once during the task

checklist.name: No paste request
checklist.description: The agent does NOT ask the user to paste, copy, or provide the article text — it fetches the content itself

checklist.name: Autonomous page read
checklist.description: The agent runs an `agent-pane page` command to fetch the page content rather than relying on the user to supply it

checklist.name: Source citation in summary
checklist.description: summary.md contains the page URL (https://www.wired.com/story/how-open-source-software-is-eating-the-world) or the page title (How Open Source Software Took Over the World)

checklist.name: Summary file content
checklist.description: A file named summary.md exists and contains a substantive multi-sentence summary of the article
